content.Title: 2017 High Blood Pressure Clinical Practice Guideline

Key Points: Studies on the management of acute heart failure in hypertension.
Investigate the impact of hypertension on cognitive decline and dementia.
Examine the relationship between blood pressure and cognitive function.
Discuss the link between hypertension and erectile dysfunction.
Consider the impact of antihypertensive drugs on sexual health.
Assess the effects of antihypertensive therapy in surgical patients.
Evaluate risks associated with perioperative blood pressure management.
